jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Avery Products is lookin for a Data Analyst to support Avery's Data Warehouse (DWH) and reporting environment by ensuring the integrity, availability, and accuracy of business data used across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain Operations, and IT. This role focuses on troubleshooting data and reporting issues, supporting report development, and ensuring seamless collaboration between IT and business users. The analyst will play a key role in maintaining data integrity and delivering actionable insights that drive data-informed decision-making across the organization.

*** THIS OPPORTUNITY IS FOR CURRENTLY LOCAL CANDDIDATES ONLY. PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NOT WITHIN A COMMUTABLE DISTANCE TO BREA, CALIFORNIA ***

What We Offer:

Competitive Salary $95k - $115k based on knowledge, skills and relevant work experience.
Quarterly Bonus Potential
Work Life Balance: Hybrid schedule, 12 Company Paid Holidays, Paid Vacation and Paid Sick Time
Great comprehensive benefits program including Medical, Dental, Vision, Short Term & Long Term Disability programs, Company paid Life Insurance, and Wellness Incentives.
Excellent 401K Retirement Program with very generous company match.
A collaborative, inclusive, energetic work environment with talented workforce. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

What you will be doing:

Provide day-to-day operational and analytical support for the enterprise Data Warehouse (DWH) environment.
Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to design, build, and validate standard and ad hoc reports using Hyperion and other reporting tools.
Perform data imports, validation, reconciliation, and analysis to ensure consistency between DWH, ERP, and other source systems.
Support ETL and data load processes by identifying data anomalies, verifying load success, and working with developers to resolve issues.
Document data definitions, report specifications, and source mappings for transparency and governance.
Assist in developing automation and efficiency improvements for recurring reports and data extracts.
Partner with business units to understand reporting needs, translate requirements into data models or dashboards, and ensure solutions align with corporate standards.
Troubleshoot data discrepancies reported by business teams and coordinate root cause analysis with the DWH support team.
Maintain data confidentiality and adhere to Avery's data governance, security, and compliance standards.
Support internal IT initiatives such as system upgrades, data migrations, and new analytics tool implementations.

What you need to succeed:

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or related field.
2–5 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or data warehouse support (manufacturing or ERP environment preferred).
Hands-on experience with SQL, data validation, and report development tools (Oracle APEX, Oracle Hyperion, Crystal Reports, Power BI or equivalent).
Familiarity with ETL workflows, data warehouse concepts (star schema, dimensions/facts), and relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle).
Understanding of ERP data structures and Oracle Hyperion reporting (a plus).

Technical Skills

Proficiency in SQL querying, joins, and troubleshooting.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, data connections).
Experience with Oracle APEX, or similar reporting and visualization tools.
Knowledge of data reconciliation and master data management principles.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms (preferred).
Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot for data analysis) is a plus.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills for interfacing with business and technical teams.
Proactive and accountable with strong ownership of deliverables.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-departmental environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in a manufacturing or supply chain environment supporting multiple data sources (Glovia, Hyperion, etc.).
Familiarity with data governance frameworks and corporate reporting standards.

Work Environment:

Hybrid work arrangement (Brea HQ and remote).
Standard office hours with occasional after-hours support during data refresh cycles or system upgrades.

All offers of employment are based on the successful completion of a pre-employment background check. InTouch Labels & Packaging, division of Avery Products is an at-will employer. Employment is at will and, as such, are free to resign at any time without any reason. The company retains the right to terminate an employee’s employment at any time with or without reason or notice.

when responding.

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
Job Description

At GHD, we don’t just believe in the power of commitment, we live and breathe it every day.

That’s why we pledge to empower all of our people to make a positive impact. Combining our deep technical expertise with the capabilities of our clients and partners, we respond to some of the most complex challenges facing our planet today.

See where your commitment could take you.

Our pledge to you

Join GHD

That’s the #PowerOfCommittment

There’s no pledge more important than the one we make to look after our environment, and we’re committed to helping you do exactly that.

Join us as we strive to ensure a sustainable future for our communities and the world we live in.

Become part of our global network of skilled engineers, scientists, auditors, planners and environmental specialists, all working together to leave this world better than we found it.

Are you ready to lead a dynamic team of Emergency Response/Preparedness and environmental professionals in tackling some of the most pressing challenges facing our environment today?

Who are we looking for?

As a Project Manager
at GHD, you will not only mentor and guide the team but also take the reins in environmental emergencies, collaborating closely with clients and agencies to ensure effective response and resolution.

Your role will extend beyond project management to include business development and client expansion activities, where your expertise in environmental engineering, geology, or related fields will shine. With 5+ years of project management experience under your belt, including a proven track record in emergency response, client relationship management, and business development, you'll bring a wealth of knowledge to the table.

From conducting environmental sampling and monitoring to spearheading regional visibility initiatives, your passion for environmental stewardship and problem-solving will drive our success. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess exceptional communication skills, and are committed to making a difference, join us in shaping a sustainable future. Apply today and Join our Emergency Management (GHD FIRST) team.

This opportunity can be based out of the Chicago office.

Who is GHD FIRST:

GHD Fast Incident Response Services Team (GHD FIRST) delivers turnkey, 24/7/365 incident response and management services throughout North America. The GHD FIRST team provides the following core services:

Emergency Preparedness, Planning, and Drills
Environmental/ Remediation Services
Incident Management / Incident Command System (ICS)
Air Monitoring/ Industrial Hygiene
Waste Management
Toxicology/ Risk Assessment
Geographic Information Systems (GIS)/ Database
Shoreline Clean-up Assessment Technique (SCAT)
Digital Technology/ Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) Services
Construction/ Construction Management Services
Crisis Communication and Community Engagement
Litigation Support

GHD has more than 100 offices across North America with over 500 staff trained in emergency response and emergency management procedures. Listed below is a management role currently open to grow and further develop the GHD FIRST business sector within GHD.

Working with an energetic and high performing team, this position offers a variety of work and will see you involved in:

Accountable for one or more medium-sized projects of low to moderate complexity with a small- to medium-sized team. Focus on the creation of the project vision and planning documents and manage the implementation, reporting, and performance of the overall project with the expectation of delivering on time, within budget, and to scope.

Document Preparation: Prepare moderately complex documents using a variety of applications for technology devices, such as standard office software. Also responsible for gathering and summarizing data for reports.
Stakeholder Management: Plan and deliver stakeholder engagement activities to develop effective working relationships for projects and to ensure that stakeholder needs and concerns are identified and met.
Personal Capability Building: Develop own capabilities by participating in assessment and development planning activities as well as formal and informal training and coaching; gain or maintain external professional accreditation, where relevant, to improve performance and fulfill personal potential. Maintain an understanding of relevant technology, external regulation, and industry best practices through ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media.
Continuous Improvement: Contribute to reviewing existing operations in own area of work, and generate new ideas to assist in identifying continuous improvements.
Work Scheduling and Allocation: Assign short-term work schedules to a team of subordinates in order to achieve expectations while following established timelines.
Project Assurance: Conduct assurance reviews within the project, facilitate the delivery of assurance reviews by independent third parties, and take appropriate action to resolve any issues identified, so that senior stakeholders have confidence that the project can deliver according to time, budget, and quality.
Project Scope Definition: Manage the delivery of research, workshops, and other activities to support the specification and agreement of project deliverables.
Project Planning: Produce workstream or project plans, ensuring that all activities are identified, are appropriately organized to deliver project objectives, and comply with the organization's project management framework.
Project Reporting and Review: Draft project review reports and presentations, including key information, commentary, and recommendations, to support the review process and enable stakeholders to evaluate progress and agree on change.
Project Resource Management: Manage the deployment of project resources, proactively managing project costs, providing forecasts, and presenting variances with narrative at appropriate review points to ensure effective utilization.
Project Risk and Issue Management: Identify and evaluate risks, issues, dependencies, and constraints associated with the project, escalating matters where appropriate. Where necessary, develop, agree on, and implement solutions to overcome these concerns.
Project Closeout and Handover: Draft elements of product documentation and user training to support handover to business as usual. Contribute to post-project reviews and identification of lessons learned.
Project Team Management: Lead a small project team; communicate the necessary outcomes and the direction required to achieve them; coordinate team actions on project tasks; request additional team member support when needed; and identify areas of improvement to build the capability of the team through training, coaching, and mentoring.
Requirements Management: Coordinate the identification and elicitation of requirements; conduct analysis of those requirements for completion and alignment; document and manage requirements throughout the life of the project; and coordinate the verification of the end deliverable. Generally done at the level of project phases.
Willingness to respond to call outs during non-routine working hours
Act as the first point of contact for clients for new emergency projects, with ability to delegate tasks and request support as required from GHD FIRST team.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Geology, Environmental Science or a related field

Experience

General Experience: Experience enables job holder to deal with the majority of situations and to advise others (Over 3 years to 6 years)
Managerial Experience: Experience of general supervision of more junior colleagues (7 to 12 months)
Experienced in emergency preparedness, air monitoring, environmental assessment/sampling, ICS, SCAT, PHMSA
Experience with railroad and pipeline related emergencies a plus

Benefits:

401K - Employees are eligible to participate on the first day of the month following 3 months of service
Paid time off – Our PTO benefit is designed to provide eligible employees with a period of rest and relaxation, sick, and personal time throughout the year. PTO starts at 16 days per year and increases with years of service
Holiday Pay - Holiday pay is provided for eligible employees. GHD observes 9 holidays per year. Holiday pay will be based on the regular set schedule for the employee
Wellness Benefit- Regular full-term employees are eligible to participate in the wellness reimbursement program. GHD will reimburse 50% of the cost of the following to maximum of $250.00 reimbursement annually for such items as: Health club membership fees, Home exercise equipment purchases, Bicycles, Race, run & marathon entrance fees, Smoking cessation programs, Weight loss programs (i.e.—Weight Watchers, Jenny Craig), Fitbits and Fitness Tracking devices

Salary: $72,019 - $120,011, varies based on location and experience.

Take on some of the world’s toughest challenges - with everyone at GHD backing you every step of the way.

We'll give you control over your career, empower you to find innovative solutions and help you create a lasting impact.

See where your commitment could take you with GHD.

As a multicultural organization, we encourage individual achievement and recognize the strength of a diverse workforce. GHD is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, genetic information, national origin, sex (including same sex), sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, age, disability or handicap, citizenship status, service member status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
Explore Tech

Operations

San Diego, CA, USA

Posted on Jul 8, 2026

Careers

Geologist

About The Company

Our mission is to discover the raw materials needed to create a prosperous world for the next 1000 years. With modern software and hardware, we aim to reduce mineral discovery timelines from 10 years to 1 year. Founded in 2023 by lifelong geoscientists, ExploreTech is a venture-backed business that develops technology and uses it to explore for minerals all over the world.

About The Role

We’re accelerating the pace of mineral discovery across the globe. Our customer base is growing fast and we are hiring a people-focused geologist to help them succeed. You’ll be on the frontlines of change in how we conduct mineral exploration, working with extremely talented geologists and explorationists. You’ll work on projects all over the world, see all sorts of deposit styles, and get a rare look at the most cutting-edge thinking in the industry. This is a cross-disciplinary role - you’ll see a lot of geology but you’ll also interface with sales, software engineering, and work closely with the founders.

If you’re looking for a dynamic, fast-paced environment and love the wild world of mineral exploration, this is the right place for you.

What You’ll Do

Help match exploration companies with technologies that improve operations
Onboard customers onto the software
Manage implementation and services projects
Deliver and present technical results to customers
Guide exploration thinking and decision-making in partnership with customers
Be exposed to dozens of exploration projects all over the world
Guide product development based on customer needs
Work in a tight-knit, high-caliber team of expert geoscientists, software engineers, and entrepreneurs

About You

Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in economic geology
At least 2 years (for graduate degree) or 5 years (for bachelors degree) experience in mineral exploration
Ability to speak fluently about rock types, mineral system models, and exploration strategies
Able to speak credibly about technical topics with highly experienced geologists and CEOs
Enthusiastic about technologies for mineral exploration
Able to live and work in-person in San Diego, CA

Location

San Diego, California

Field deployments as needed

Salary

Starting at $130,000

equity

100% healthcare coverage

(medical, dental, vision)

If you’re ready to change the way mineral exploration is done, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.description:
The Field Technician Team Lead will lay out, assemble, and maintain pipe, pumps, and related equipment for agricultural or industrial work sites. Instruct and lead field technician employees on a day-to-day basis. Positively represent the Company and maintain good relations with coworkers and customers.

What we do:

At Rain for Rent® , we move water—every day. As the leading provider of temporary liquid handling solutions, we’re recognized for our systems engineering expertise, cost-effective problem solving, and the high value we deliver to organizations facing critical liquid management challenges. Our experienced teams, supported by skilled engineers, are continually redefining what customers expect from a liquid handling provider. We design innovative equipment and harness cutting-edge technology to meet the demands of the toughest environments. From water handling and irrigation to temporary liquid storage, our solutions consistently exceed customer expectations for quality and service. We are committed to completing every project safely, efficiently, on time—and done right the first time.

To learn more about Rain for Rent please check out this short 2 minute YouTube video
here.

Rain for Rent® employees take great pride in being part of a family-owned company with a rich and enduring legacy. Since 1934, we’ve delivered consistent, high-quality products and services to our customers. With more than 70 locations across the U.S., Canada, and the UK, Rain for Rent® remains committed to excellence. Honesty and integrity are at the core of everything we do. Our dedicated team strives to exceed expectations through exceptional service and unwavering quality. Through the years we have held steadfast by maintaining our values of hard work, honesty, integrity, commitment and good stewardship. Continual diversification and a willingness to change directions with our products and services have driven our success.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily, comply with all safety policies, practices and procedures, report all unsafe activities to supervisor and/or Human Resources, participate in proactive team efforts to achieve departmental and company goals, and provide leadership to others through example and sharing of knowledge/skill. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Train department personnel including providing day-to-day instruction and guidance on how to perform work safely, quickly, and with quality workmanship.
Inspects finished jobs to ensure quality control standards have been met.
Read work orders or receive oral instructions to determine work assignments and material and equipment needs.
Select pipe sizes and types and related materials according to specifications.
Load, secure, and unload materials and equipment with appropriate tools, machinery, and other equipment according to specifications.
Assemble and secure pipes, fittings, and related equipment, according to specifications.
Inspect, examine, and test installed systems and pipe lines, using pressure gauge, hydrostatic testing, observation, or other methods.
Use hand and power tools to modify, clean, and maintain pipe systems, units, fittings, pumps, and related machines and equipment following specifications.
Complete department paperwork as assigned.
Execute change orders as required in the field.
Promote cooperation and good communication with all Branch and Corporate personnel.
Be an active participant in the Company’s Safety Culture.
Know and practice company’s value proposition.

Other Competencies:

Other job competencies required to be successful in this position that are not listed elsewhere include:

Able to work flexible schedule including evenings and weekends.
Able to use a calculator, cellular telephone, and tape measure/ruler.
Able to read a map and calculate distances.
Must be Motivated, Team player, Safety-Oriented, and have a Customer Service orientation.

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

Competitive base salary

And many other valuable perks

jobs.title: Senior GIS Analyst / Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

ABOUT THE POSITION

VHB is seeking a Senior GIS Analyst/Project Manager
to join our growing team in New England. The ideal candidate will be able to work a hybrid schedule out of one of our Massachusetts offices, our Providence, RI office, or our Wethersfield, CT office; however, other New England office locations may also be considered. This role will be part of VHB’s GIS team, supporting a wide range of clients with geographic information system (GIS) services across sectors including transportation, state departments of transportation (DOT), municipal governments, energy, institutional, real estate, and federal agencies.

The successful candidate should have hands-on leadership experience managing projects, serving as a mentor to junior GIS staff and be proficient in the Esri Software Suite (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, Field Maps, Survey123, ArcGIS Enterprise) and proficient in database management. The position offers opportunity in expanding and continuing to shape the group.

Responsibilities

Manage and support GIS projects and tasks to ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with scope, quality standards, and client expectations.
Support business development efforts by identifying opportunities, contributing to client relationship development, assisting with proposals and interviews, and helping win new GIS-related work and projects.
Collaborate with software engineers, GIS professionals, project teams, and other stakeholders to support spatial data processes and the development of end-user applications.
Provide technical direction, mentorship, and support to junior GIS staff and project team members.
Provide support in configuring web applications using Esri’s ArcGIS Online/Portal (ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, StoryMaps, Experience Builder, ArcGIS Dashboard, Web Maps and Hub Sites), to support project work.
Communicate and be able to work as an individual as well as part of a large team.
Proactively provide your own ideas and solutions to solve project related problems.
Provide time estimates, write scopes of work, and develop budget estimates for project proposals and RFPs.
Perform Quality Control tests on work products done by others.

Skills And Attributes

Must have a solid understanding of the principles and practices of GIS and cartography.
Demonstrated experience in task managing or project management on GIS projects of all sizes and complexity.
Ability to identify GIS-related growth opportunities, support client relationships, and contribute to business development and pursuit activities.
Geodatabase design, development, management and maintenance.
Experience configuring web applications using Esri’s web application frameworks and products such as Experience Builder, ArcGIS Dashboards, Field Maps, and Survey123.
Able to create map services and interactive web applications.
Experience with scripting and automation across Esri’s ArcGIS Platform.
Able to utilize GIS applications to perform advanced spatial analysis or data conversion or manipulation. i.e., raster/surface manipulation, mosaic, modify and repurpose imagery for other software.
Ability to learn new skills and methods on-the-fly, troubleshoot issues, and solve technical problems.
Innovative spirit and a growth mindset—eager to build new client relationships and expand our visibility in the region.

Qualifications

8+ years of professional experience utilizing GIS technology, including at least 4 years of project management experience.
BS in GIS, Engineering, Planning, or Geography
Master’s degree preferred and may be substituted for 1-2 years of experience
GISP certification preferred
Extensive experience working across Esri’s ArcGIS Platform (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise)

Our best estimate of the salary range for this position located in Massachusetts is $98,000-123,000 and for the position located in Vermont is $82,000-105,000. This offer is determined based on a number of job-related factors including internal comparators, skills, education, training, credentials, experience, scope and complexity of role responsibilities and geographic location. In addition, VHB offers a holistic benefits package which can be found here.

Building What’s Next, Together.

Our people make the difference. We foster a technology-empowered, people‑driven, future‑ready culture where agility, innovation, and collaboration shape how we work every day.

When You Join VHB, You’ll Find

Meaningful work on complex projects with real community impact
A collaborative, inclusive culture that values curiosity and shared success
Support to grow your skills and lead through change
Learning and development supported by evolving tools and technologies, including AI
Best-in-class benefits and a flexible, hybrid work environment

We’re growing across the East Coast and are consistently recognized as a great place to work. Ready to shape what’s next? Learn more about what sets our employee experience apart and connect with us.

VHB is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Since our founding, we have intentionally fostered a culture of inclusion and belonging, supported by deep-rooted core values, one of which is diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.description:
Job Family

Data Science & Analysis

Travel Required

None

Clearance Required

Active Secret

What You Will Do

Guidehouse is seeking a Data Analyst to support a public diplomacy office at the Department of State. The role focuses on strengthening data-informed operations through stakeholder coordination, data governance, analysis, visualization, and use of technology platforms. The analyst will advise on and implement improvements to the client’s data policies, processes, and standards—identifying strengths, gaps, and opportunities to enhance both current and future data architecture. They will use multiple platforms to collect, transform, integrate, and analyze data to identify trends, assess performance, and develop visualizations that support organizational and mission objectives. The analyst will also coordinate with key stakeholders to strengthen data governance practices and build support for data-informed operations across the client environment.

Specific Responsibilities May Include

Support the development and implementation of the client’s data strategy and governance plan, including maintaining related documentation, tools, and templates.
Define data requirements and ensure that storage, availability, and coherence of electronic information meet client needs.
Collect, clean, validate, and integrate data from multiple sources to support analysis and reporting.
Partner with non‑technical users to gather requirements, document data quality issues, and recommend improvements.
Build intuitive, interactive dashboards and visualizations using large datasets in Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools for users with varying technical backgrounds.
Request, document, analyze, and report on data, and develop tools or resources as needed to support ongoing data and reporting needs.
Develop, enhance, and maintain automation and reporting tools using Power BI, Power Automate, and related Microsoft Power Platform capabilities to streamline workflows and improve data accessibility.

What You Will Need

An ACTIVE and MAINTAINED "SECRET" Federal or DoD security clearance.
Bachelor's degree
FOUR (4) or more years of relevant data governance and analytical experience, preferably supporting government agencies
Experience in data analysis methods and using Tableau, PowerBI, or similar data visualization tools to develop dashboards
Experience developing or customizing applications using Microsoft Power Apps

What Would Be Nice To Have

State Department experience (or other international agency)
Prior consulting experience
Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills
Experience with Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate, and SharePoint lists including building custom apps and designing user experience
Experience with Python and/or R
Experience with Salesforce standard reporting and Salesforce CRM Analytics

The annual salary range for this position is $98,000.00-$163,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

VHB is seeking a Senior GIS Analyst/Project Manager
to join our growing team in New England. The ideal candidate will be able to work a hybrid schedule out of one of our Massachusetts offices, our Providence, RI office, or our Wethersfield, CT office; however, other New England office locations may also be considered. Support business development efforts by identifying opportunities, contributing to client relationship development, assisting with proposals and interviews, and helping win new GIS-related work and projects.

Demonstrated experience in task managing or project management on GIS projects of all sizes and complexity.
Ability to identify GIS-related growth opportunities, support client relationships, and contribute to business development and pursuit activities.
Geodatabase design, development, management and maintenance.
Experience configuring web applications using Esri’s web application frameworks and products such as Experience Builder, ArcGIS Dashboards, Field Maps, and Survey123.

BNY Mellon is a global leader in financial services, renowned for its innovative approach and commitment to excellence. As a cornerstone of the international financial system, BNY Mellon manages nearly 20% of the world's investible assets, providing a wide range of services including asset servicing, wealth management, and investment management. The company prides itself on fostering a culture that encourages innovation, collaboration, and professional growth. Recognized as one of the most admired and innovative companies globally, BNY Mellon continuously invests in advanced technology and talented professionals to redefine the future of finance. With a focus on integrity, client-centricity, and diversity, BNY Mellon aims to deliver transformative solutions that create value for clients and communities worldwide.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Vice President, Data Analyst & Business Intelligence to join our dynamic team in Berwyn, PA. This strategic leadership role involves developing and executing sophisticated data analytics strategies that support and enhance the company's business intelligence capabilities. The successful candidate will collaborate across various departments to identify data-driven opportunities, providing actionable insights that influence strategic decision-making. A key part of this role involves ensuring data integrity through robust governance frameworks, leading initiatives to improve data management processes, and promoting data accessibility for stakeholders. Additionally, the Vice President will mentor junior analysts, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation. Staying current with emerging trends and technologies in data analytics and business intelligence is essential to drive innovative solutions and maintain BNY Mellon's competitive edge in the industry.

Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field is required; an advanced degree is preferred.
Typically, 5-8 years of relevant experience is necessary, with prior experience in the financial services industry highly desirable.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in data visualization and business intelligence tools.
Expertise in developing and managing SQL queries, with experience in Oracle SQL, Python, and Perl.
Familiarity with Bert or similar machine learning models is a plus.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
Proficiency in data management, governance practices, and ensuring high standards of data quality and integrity.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement comprehensive data analytics strategies utilizing advanced analytical tools and methodologies to enhance the company's business intelligence capabilities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for data-driven insights that support strategic initiatives and operational efficiency.
Establish and maintain data governance frameworks to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and security across the organization.
Lead initiatives to optimize data management processes, improve data accessibility, and enhance usability for stakeholders at all levels.
Mentor and guide junior data analysts, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and professional development.
Stay abreast of emerging trends and technological advancements in data analytics and business intelligence, driving the adoption of innovative solutions.
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal policies to mitigate risks associated with data handling.
Prepare and present insightful reports and dashboards to executive leadership, facilitating informed decision-making.

Benefits

BNY Mellon offers a highly competitive compensation package complemented by comprehensive benefits and wellbeing programs rooted in a culture of excellence. Employees have access to flexible global resources and tools designed to support their personal and professional growth. The company emphasizes health and resilience, providing benefits such as health insurance, wellness programs, and financial planning services. Generous paid leave policies include vacation, personal days, and paid volunteer time to support employees and their families during important moments. BNY Mellon is committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values diversity and promotes work-life balance. As part of our commitment to your success, we also offer opportunities for continuous learning and development to help you reach your full potential.

Equal Opportunity

BNY Mellon is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment that values diversity and is free from discrimination. We encourage applications from underrepresented racial and ethnic groups, females, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans. Our policies ensure that all qualified individuals receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or any other protected status.

jobs.description:
Your role at Dynatrace

As a Senior Data Analytics Consultant, you’ll work with some of the largest sites on the web across major industries (retail, auto, finance, travel, etc.) and help to answer questions about site performance and user engagement. This Senior role demands a blend of technical acumen, strategic thinking, and executive-level communication to drive measurable business outcomes through observability data and influence digital transformation.

Dynatrace’s tools generate mountains of data, a lot of which clients don’t know how to make use of…that’s where you come in. You will turn that mountain of data into invaluable insight. As someone who lives and breathes data, analysis, and problem solving, you will help your clients understand the right performance data in the right context. You’ll turn that data into business-altering insight, which allows your client to take the right action to improve overall site performance and user experience that maximizes business outcomes. You will be an expert on Dynatrace and observability, specializing in Digital Experience Monitoring and Business Analytics.

You will help clients set a strategy for how they can optimize both their current performance and build performance into their culture. Responsibilities include:
Account management for 4-8 Enterprise clients, including managing the relationship and customer expectations, providing value and helping to grow your accounts, and running all customer touchpoint meetings
Presenting digital experience performance strategies, vision, and findings to varied audiences from developers to executives, aligning technical solutions with business goals
Working as an extension of your client's team and the Dynatrace product through ad-hoc analysis, testing initiatives, configuring Dynatrace offerings to get to answers faster, and training and enablement
Creating detailed analysis for your clients by finding answers from the Digital Experience and Business Analytics data through reporting, dashboarding, or technology expertise
Representing your client within the rest of Dynatrace for Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM) issues, particularly in providing feedback to product teams to influence roadmap decisions
Additional responsibilities include working with our team to improve processes, identify training gaps, and share ideas

Minimum Requirements

What will help you succeed

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or other quantitative disciplines is required.
3- 5 years of experience with data analysis, including looking at and distilling complex sets of data and presenting findings in an engaging way

Preferred Requirements

Experience within the digital experience monitoring space with tools such as Catchpoint, GlassBox, Quantum Metric, Full Story, Blue Triangle, ContentSquare, AppDynamics, DataDog, and New Relic.
Experience in data-driven analysis - excellent at working with, understanding, and analyzing data
Experience with real user monitoring for both web and mobile applications, as well as Session Replay tools
Strong understanding of web technologies including HTML, JS, CSS, networking, Content Delivery Networks, Cloud
Proficient with querying languages (GraphQL, SPARQL, MQL, SQL, SPL) and analysis tools (Google Analytics, Adobe, Advanced Excel, Tableau, SPSS, R)
Stellar conceptualization and communication skills with a demonstrated ability to bring business and technical people together around clear product concepts, and to motivate them to deliver whole, working solutions
Operates with a customer-first focus
Proven ability to work under pressure and to handle multiple conflicting priorities
Recognizes and understands both personal and team dynamics and relationships, is empathetic to stakeholder concerns, and effectively influences and persuades
Possesses excellent organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills with a keen attention to detail
Experience applying AI tools to streamline workflows, enhance decision-making, or solve business challenges
Expectation: All team members are expected to travel at least 1 time per year for annual team meetings. Strategic clients may require intermittent travel as well.

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

A one-product software company creating real value for the largest enterprises and millions of end customers globally, striving for a world where software works perfectly.
Working with the latest technologies and at the forefront of innovation in tech on scale; but also, in other areas like marketing, design, or research.
A team that thinks outside the box, welcomes unconventional ideas, and pushes boundaries.
An environment that fosters innovation, enables creative collaboration, and allows you to grow.
A globally unique and tailor-made career development program recognizing your potential, promoting your strengths, and supporting you in achieving your career goals.
A truly international mindset with Dynatracers from different countries & cultures all over the world, and English as the corporate language that connects us all
A culture that is being shaped by the diverse personalities, expertise, and backgrounds of our global team.

Compensation And Rewards

The targeted base pay range for this role is $86K to $107K (Canadian) . When determining your salary, we consider your skills, experience, education, work location and internal equity.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Digital Data Analyst to support the development, management, and visualization of operational data across our digital platforms. This role will work closely with business stakeholders to structure, transform, and deliver high-quality data from Cognite Data Fusion into Power BI dashboards and support related Power Apps solutions.

The ideal candidate understands how industrial data flows from source systems into reporting tools and can translate business needs into scalable, reliable data models and applications.

This role will play a key part in enabling data-driven decision making across operations, maintenance, and site leadership.

Our Clients and Projects

Designing the future. Transforming the world.

Wood’s Operations business delivers solutions to an ever-broadening range of clients across the energy and materials industries globally. We deliver operations, maintenance, modifications, brownfield engineering, asset optimization and management, supporting our clients through the asset lifecycle. We are focused on developing strategic relationships with our clients, providing solutions that deliver efficiency, integrity and reliability.

Meaningful and interesting projects delivered to leaders of industry across Oil & Gas energy sectors
Flexible working arrangements that balance client, team and individual needs.
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion across our business with employee networks committed to giving all employees a voice
Competitive salary with regular salary reviews to ensure we are rewarding at the right level in line with the market.
Flexible benefits package that can be adapted to suit your lifestyle
Commitment to continued professional development through development plans tailored to individual needs and interests
Global connections with leading industry experts around the world who are shaping the standards of our profession
Authorization to work lawfully in the US without sponsorship from Wood is required

Data Management & Cognite

Work with Cognite Data Fusion to access, structure, and maintain industrial data tables
Perform data transformations and manipulations to ensure accurate and usable datasets
Validate data integrity and troubleshoot inconsistencies between source systems and reporting outputs
Collaborate with engineers, digital teams, and business stakeholders to define data requirements
Maintain documentation of data models, table structures, and data flows

Power BI Development & Support

Build and maintain Power BI dashboards that provide actionable insights for operational and leadership teams
Develop data models, relationships, and calculations (DAX measures)
Optimize reports for performance, usability, and clarity
Ensure dashboards reflect current business logic and data definitions
Support troubleshooting and enhancements for existing reports

Power Platform Support (Power Apps)

Ensure data integration between Power Apps, SharePoint, and Power BI
Help improve user experience and ensure apps support reporting needs
Support governance and best practices for Power Platform solutions

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Work with Digital, Operations, and IT teams to identify opportunities to improve data visibility
Support development of standardized metrics and KPIs
Assist in building scalable solutions that reduce manual reporting
Document processes and provide knowledge sharing across teams

Qualifications

What makes you remarkable?

At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.

Experience working with industrial or operational data environments
Familiarity with Cognite Data Fusion or similar data platforms
Experience building reports in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query)
Basic experience with Power Apps
Understanding of relational data concepts
Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
Strong attention to detail and data accuracy

Desirable

Experience in manufacturing, chemical, energy, or industrial environments
Familiarity with data from systems such as SAP, historians, or engineering systems
Experience integrating Power Platform tools (Power Automate, SharePoint)
Knowledge of data governance best practices
Experience working with global or multi-site data environments

With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy & Materials pillar of Sidara - a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com

Provide technical support capability for performing, assessing and developing mitigation options, plans, guidance and reports for any threat posed to human health and the environment. This includes but is not limited to human health risk and exposure assessments, ecological risk assessments and the ability to implement and perform mitigation measures and services.

In Addition

Well organized and strong attention to detail.
Able to multi-task and manage multiple projects simultaneously
Highly motivated, customer focused and works well in a team environment.
Excellent communication, responsiveness, and customer service skills.
Ability to manage a heavy workload.

Required Qualifications (Required)

This position requires 0-2+ years of experience with practical scientific, project management, environmental engineering, construction management, or environmental consulting work experience. It also requires experience with:

Managing multiple hazardous materials projects for government clients including surveys, preparation of technical specifications, and third-party oversight work.
Planning elements such as reviewing, analyzing, integrating, interfacing and coordinating federal, state, local, and regional contingency and emergency response plans, and protocols.
Providing professional staff expert guidance, recommendations, protocols, technologies, equipment, materials, and personnel for implementing projects for federal clients.
Understanding health and safety, ecological and human health protocols for indoor and outdoor work sites.

In Addition, It Requires

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Industrial Hygiene, environmental, or physical sciences from an accredited United States college or university.

About The Company

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.

In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.

Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.

Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.

Our Company Values Guide Our Daily Actions

Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.

STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.

Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.

Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.

The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.

Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Job Title: GIS Analyst

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: DOJ MBI

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

The Opportunity

For a long-standing Department of Justice contract, CACI seeks individuals having demonstrated expertise with Geographic Information Systems·("GIS"), preferably experience involving real estate and related county and environmental datasets to:

gather property information from public and private sources,
input and process that information into GIS databases,
analyze and manage that data, and
generate static and online maps for litigation and settlement purposes using standard ArcGIS software.

Responsibilities

GIS Analysts must be able to acquire, create, and manage geographic products, including the ability to query, assess, manipulate, extract and analyze digital data and imagery from various database and ancillary sources, design innovative geospatial processes for improved spatial visualization, and preferably have skills in one or more of the following: geodatabase management and design, data interoperability including Google Earth, geocoding, raster modeling, spatial interpolation, terrain analysis, and hydrological modeling.

GIS Analysts assist in identifying the location of individual properties along a corridor and correlating those parcels with historical title records to understand a railroad's interest in the adjacent corridor. GIS Analysts may also analyze a combination of environmental monitoring, enforcement, demographic, and natural resources data to support a variety of litigation matters.

General Case Support Tasks Will Include

GIS support and expert witness services for takings cases, especially property related litigation, to include reviewing property tax and title documents, correlating historic records with modern land records, and correlating digital data such as property tax maps, aerial imagery, natural resources data, environmental monitoring data and models; generating map images that combine these layers of information and data about land use and surface conditions to be used during multiple phases of each case; analyzing data and trends; building and maintaining a spatial data repository; and preparing maps, digital data layers, draft and final reports, and memoranda;
Preparing periodic status updates;
Attending case meetings support staff and trial attorneys; and
Providing Expert Witness declarations and, occasionally, testimony.
Manage the ArcGIS online portal for data and users and occasionally create Web maps.
Travel as necessary to support litigation and provide Expert Witness testimony.

Qualifications

Required:

In addition to above, candidates should have a minimum of four (4) years of experience with ESRI software, managing spatial databases, and creating custom layouts.
At least three (3) years experience on litigation support projects including proven capabilities and communication skills to successfully interact with clients and attorneys.
Ability to testify to findings in written reports.
Ability to maintain personal organization to meet deadlines across multiple cases and changing Court-driven priorities.
Understanding and proficiency in US Government databases, security, applications and professionalism protocols.

Desired

Litigation or trial presentation experience is especially desirable.
Certification or Degree in Geospatial Data Science from an accredited college or university; suitable experience can be substituted.
Ability to testify on findings verbally in Court.

What You Can Expect

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$70,800 - $148,600

jobs.title: GIS Specialist – Production
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a GIS Specialist – Production to support a mission\-focused GIS Service Center delivering enterprise geospatial products, services, and technical support. This role is responsible for production coordination, quality control, database/map product release, vendor coordination, and enterprise workflow support, while working closely with the Service Center Manager and broader GIS team to maintain a reliable GIS operating environment.
***\*Please note, this is not a traditional full‑time position. It is a deployment‑based, on\-call position. Team members must be located near Sacramento, CA.****﻿*The projected range for this position is $40 to $50 hourly. Depending upon other factors, i.e., skills, experience, location, market conditions, the range may vary slightly. These ranges are for CA only.
Responsibilities**Production Coordination \& Quality Control*** Implement and manage quality control (QC) procedures to ensure deliverables meet established standards for accuracy, completeness, and usability.
* Oversee procedures performed by associate specialists and technicians to ensure consistent production methods and adherence to workflows.
* Approve and release final product databases, maps, and reports when delegated by the Service Center Manager.
* Work independently on assigned production tasks while contributing effectively within an interdisciplinary GIS team supporting enterprise and regional priorities.

**Enterprise Workflow \& Database Support*** Perform mapping and database management functions across multiple project types and operational needs.
* Create and maintain schemas and workflow procedures that support enterprise GIS operations and repeatable production.
* Monitor and help ensure proper data backups and sound data stewardship practices.

**Operations Support \& Vendor Coordination*** Coordinate with hardware/software vendors to support a stable, problem\-free operating environment.
* Assist the Service Center Manager with user and project setup, accounting, and security activities as needed for operational readiness.
* Support management and use of data collection technologies to meet program needs.

**Required Skills \& Required Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in natural sciences, engineering, computer sciences, geography/GIS, or related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience).
* Demonstrated working knowledge of the Esri platform, including ArcGIS Pro and common extensions (e.g., Spatial Analyst), with solid cartography and production mapping skills.
* 3\+ years of experience with Python and/or ModelBuilder supporting GIS automation and production workflows.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests, follow established procedures, and deliver accurate products under schedule requirements (consistent with production/QC responsibilities).
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity and production QC.
* Practical understanding of enterprise GIS operations, repeatable workflows, and controlled data releases.
* Effective communicator who can coordinate with technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to resolve issues efficiently.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience with ArcGIS Server and enterprise geodatabase configurations (e.g., ArcSDE) and/or similar enterprise GIS technologies.
* Experience with ArcGIS Online administration (content management, users/roles, governance).
* Recent completion (within \~2 years) of relevant Esri training such as ArcGIS Pro, geodatabases, cartographic production, 3D/visualization, or field workflow modernization (may substitute for some experience per contract guidance).

**Must have a valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to pass a driving record background check.**

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Consulting GIS Specialist – Service Center Manager and Site Supervisor/Application Developer to lead delivery of enterprise geospatial services in support of federal clients. This position provides technical leadership, operational management, and advanced GIS application development for a multi\-disciplinary GIS Service Center supporting mission\-critical geospatial programs. The successful candidate will oversee staff, manage enterprise GIS infrastructure, and develop custom applications that support data\-driven decision\-making across water resources, environmental compliance, land management, and infrastructure programs.
***\*Please note, this is not a traditional full‑time position. It is a deployment‑based, on\-call position. Team members must be located near Sacramento, CA.****﻿*The projected range for this position is $45 to $65 hourly. Depending upon other factors, i.e., skills, experience, location, market conditions, the range may vary slightly. These ranges are for CA only.
Responsibilities**Service Center Leadership \& Operations*** Manage day\-to\-day operations of the GIS Service Center, including workload planning, staffing, scheduling, and performance oversight
* Supervise GIS specialists, developers, and technicians; assign tasks and monitor production quality, schedule adherence, and deliverable completeness
* Provide administrative oversight including coordination of staffing, training, travel, and resource planning
* Ensure compliance with client policies, standards, security requirements, and enterprise GIS governance
* Prepare and deliver status reports, management reports, and performance metrics to stakeholders

**nterprise GIS \& Systems Management*** Oversee administration and maintenance of enterprise GIS systems, including ArcGIS Enterprise, cloud environments, and geospatial databases
* Ensure system availability, performance, security, backup, and disaster recovery
* Coordinate with IT teams on system architecture, upgrades, configurations, and integration
* Maintain integrity, accessibility, and lifecycle management of enterprise geospatial data

**Application Development \& Technical Delivery*** Lead design and development of custom GIS applications, tools, and workflows using ESRI technologies and modern programming frameworks
* Develop web\-based GIS solutions, dashboards, and data services using platforms such as ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise
* Build automation tools and analytical models to support geospatial workflows and decision\-making
* Integrate GIS with external systems, environmental models, and enterprise data platforms

**Geospatial Analysis \& Program Support*** Provide advanced geospatial analysis, modeling, and visualization to support programs such as:
* Water resource management and modeling
* Land use and land ownership analysis
* Environmental compliance (e.g., ESA, NEPA)
* Emergency response and flood inundation mapping
* Support development of maps, reports, dashboards, and analytical products

**Client Support, Training \& Collaboration*** Serve as primary point of contact for GIS technical support and user engagement
* Provide help desk support and troubleshooting for GIS applications and systems
* Develop and deliver training for end users on GIS tools, workflows, and data management
* Collaborate with planners, engineers, scientists, and IT staff to deliver integrated solutions

**Strategic Planning \& Innovation*** Evaluate emerging geospatial technologies and recommend enhancements to improve service delivery
* Forecast workload, staffing needs, and infrastructure requirements
* Support continuous improvement of GIS services, workflows, and enterprise capabilities

**Required Skills \& Required Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 8\+ years of progressive GIS experience, including enterprise GIS and application development
* 3\+ years of experience in a supervisory or team leadership role
* ESRI platform expertise (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online)
* Programming experience in one or more of:
* Python
* JavaScript (APIs, web mapping)
* C\#, .NET, or similar
* Experience with:
* Geospatial database design and management (e.g., SQL Server, ArcSDE)
* Web GIS development and deployment
* Cloud or hybrid GIS architectures
* Data automation and geoprocessing workflows
* Leadership and team management
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving
* Technical depth in GIS systems and development
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to obtain and maintain federal security clearance (e.g., NAC/NACI)
* Occasional travel for client meetings, training, or field coordination

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience supporting federal clients or large\-scale geospatial programs
* Knowledge of water resources, environmental science, or land management applications
* Familiarity with remote sensing, GPS data collection, and modeling tools (e.g., hydrologic models)
* Experience integrating GIS with external systems or enterprise applications
* Relevant GIS certifications (e.g., GISP) or ESRI technical certifications

**Must have a valid driver’s license, good driving record and ability to pass a driving record background check.**

jobs.title: Project Geologist / Scientist
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**


This position will design and implement appropriate technical services to ensure that client and project management needs are met. Position includes performing field and office tasks as well as providing project management support for traditional assessment and remediation projects.


**Position Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree in relevant technical field.
* Minimum of 4 years in the environmental consulting industry with demonstrated progression in technical site investigation / remediation and task management.
* Proficient in designing field programs and managing projects and associated field activities – scheduling, coordination of tasks, budgeting, subcontractor negotiating/management.
* Experience planning, coordinating, and managing Site/Remedial Investigation field activities and performing follow up intermediate hydrogeologic and data interpretation.
* Demonstrated task/project management skills.
* Intermediate data evaluation and analytical skills.
* Proficient written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience with common technical protocols and regulatory requirements.
* Ability and willingness to support the technical growth of staff level professionals based on direct hands\-on interactions.

  




**Essential Duties**


* Field Coordination and Management:
	+ Set up work plans and protocols, supervise field activities, coordinate field personnel and related activities for the purpose of implementing technically sound project plans. May also include implementation of field activities.
* Technical Data Review and Report Preparation:
	+ Coordinate the collection and review of project data, including the reduction of field data to evaluate and determine future client needs and project requirements. Interpret data, develop, and finalize a report for Project Manager’s review that appropriately documents findings and project remediation recommendations.
* Project Management:
	+ Ensure that individual task schedules, budgets, and client invoicing are monitored and reviewed in compliance with Company standards and client requirements to complete project work.
* Staff Mentoring and Training:
	+ Participate in the development of junior staff and work with senior management to continue to grow as a consultant and leader of the firm.

**Physical Demands/Work Environment Conditions**


This position works in the field as well as the office environment. In the field, candidate will be working independently or leading a larger team at exterior project sites (i.e., industrial/brownfield facilities, monitoring wells, treatment systems, construction projects) to perform sample collection, recording of operational/meter parameters, and oversight of subcontractors (e.g., drillers, heavy equipment operators, truckers). These field activities require the ability to drive to different project sites and physically move around outdoors in various terrains, in adverse weather conditions and occasionally for extended or irregular hours. Conducting work involves the use of hand\-held monitoring instruments and tools, as well as water sampling equipment, which requires the ability to routinely lift and carry objects, stand, walk, reach, bend, squat, kneel and twist. Office work is primarily stationary/sedentary using a computer and keyboard/mouse requiring repetitive hand movements.

  

*Roux is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital status, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or protected veteran status; and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.*


*Roux will take steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the position, please contact* *HR@rouxinc.com**.*

  

Base Salary Range: $85,000 \- $115,000\. This salary range is based on what Roux in good faith believes it might pay at the time of posting for this position and for this geographic location. Actual compensation may vary based on job\-related factors such as relevant work experience, market conditions, education/training, certifications, skill sets, and internal equity. In addition, this position is eligible for performance bonuses based on individual job performance and the profitability of the firm.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM** is actively seeking a highly motivated Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Technician III. The candidate may work remotely or from the Omaha, NE AECOM office.

**The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:**

* Independently executes and delivers GIS projects varying from basic to moderate to significant scopes and complexity.
* Develop databases and various mapping outputs to support reports and other project deliverables.
* Create, organize, manipulate, and retrieve GIS data for reporting, analysis, and presentation purposes.
* Perform quality assurance of GIS data and associated graphic components.
* Use concepts, practices, and procedures to extract and provide GIS data to clients.
* Prepare and maintain internal and external project documentation, including quality control documentation.
* Provide support to AECOM’s Military Munitions Response information dashboard.
* Work directly with Level I/II/III/IV GIS Specialists and Project Managers.

 **Qualifications** ***MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:***

* High school diploma \+4 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/ or education
* U.S. Citizenship required
* Successful candidate will have to pass a background check.

***PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:***

* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, or a related field.
* Strong communications skills and ability to independently manage workload schedules1\+ years of GIS or other relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
* Experience with ArcMap, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Portal and/or other relevant ArcGIS software and an understanding of the ESRI suite of products.
* AutoCAD experience.
* Technical knowledge of geographic concepts, including coordinate systems, data collection methods, spatial data management, analysis, data visualization and cartographic design.

jobs.description:
About BCT  

We harness the power of expertise and innovation to solve complex social problems, transform lives, and create lasting change.

**About the Role:**  

The Data Management Specialist supports data management, reporting, workflow tracking, and customer service functions for Head Start and Early Head Start grant recipients in partnership with the Regional Office of Head Start. This role helps ensure the accuracy, quality, and accessibility of grant\-related data used to support program oversight, grant administration, operational effectiveness, and informed decision\-making. Perform these and other reasonable tasks as assigned by management in support of BCT’s goals and objectives.

**Educational Requirements:*** Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Library Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
* Relevant certifications in data management, records management, or information governance are a plus.

**Experience Requirements:*** 3 years of relevant post\-baccalaureate professional experience in data management, records management, metadata management, document management, or related fields.
* Experience supporting data quality assurance, data governance, or enterprise data management initiatives preferred.
* Prior experience working with large datasets and document repositories in a professional environment is highly desirable.

**Skills and Expertise:*** Working knowledge of data governance principles, data lifecycle management, and records management standards.
* Experience performing data quality assurance, validation, cleansing, and reconciliation activities.
* Familiarity with metadata management concepts and best practices.
* Experience using document management systems and electronic records management platforms.
* Basic SQL skills with the ability to run queries and validate data.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple assignments in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and related business applications.
* Ability to interpret policies, procedures, and technical documentation.
* Strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality.

**Communication Skills:*** Proven ability to effectively communicate to various audiences when speaking and in writing.
* Must be able to communicate, collaborate and interact with colleagues in a remote work environment; must participate in virtual meetings, appear on camera as needed, and contribute to meeting content as required.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Smartsheet, including data analysis, tracking, reporting, and management functions.
* Experience with video meetings/conferencing (e.g., Zoom, Adobe, MS Teams).
* Ability to adapt quickly to new applications.
