Our canine friends are invited to “work” in the office with us!

Position Details

Insignia is seeking an experienced Lead Geographic Information System (GIS) Specialist to support our vision of being our clients’ most trusted partner by delivering excellence with integrity. This is a full-time hybrid role that is based out of Insignia’s Menlo Park headquarters or Encinitas office. This role is open to remote applicants; however, regular client interaction and availability for meetings for California-based clients within the Pacific Time Zone is required. The Lead GIS Specialist will provide advanced technical expertise in acquiring, organizing, analyzing, and mapping GIS data while ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and consistency across deliverables. The position requires coordinating with project managers and directly interfacing with clients to support project planning, execution, and delivery.

Job Description

Research, implement, and apply industry-standard methods for GIS data analysis.
Manage and organize geospatial data for accessibility, accuracy, and consistency.
Develop high-quality maps, datasets, and analysis products in support of client deliverables.
Provide field staff and biologists with maps, mobile GIS devices, and Global Positioning System units.
Process and analyze field-collected data (e.g., wetland delineations, vegetation mapping, biological survey data).
Coordinate with Project Managers to integrate GIS tasks into project schedules and budgets.
Serve as a GIS technical lead in client meetings and support proposal development, including scopes and cost estimates.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in geography, GIS, environmental science, planning, or a related field.
At least 5 years of professional GIS experience, with at least 4 years of environmental consulting strongly preferred.
Strong technical expertise with Esri platforms: ArcGIS Pro, ArcMap, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Field Maps.
Experience creating, editing, publishing, and managing services in Esri’s ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online.
Advanced proficiency in geospatial data management, including vector and point data types, symbology, stored displays, and dataset creation.
Strong knowledge of network connectivity concepts for electric, gas, and water GIS.
Proficiency with geoprocessing tools, GIS data migration/conversion, and data analysis techniques.
Demonstrated programming and automation skills (e.g., Python, Arcade, ModelBuilder, and SQL).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, and related platforms.
Ability to prepare technical documentation and develop testing strategies to validate solutions.
Proven ability to complete projects within time and budget constraints.
Detail-oriented, highly organized, proactive, and capable of working independently.
Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate with Project Managers and interface directly with clients.

Benefits And Compensation

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The annual salary range for this position is $70,000 to $100,000.
Insignia is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits program to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Insignia benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, employee assistance program, retirement savings plan, and bonuses.

How to Apply

Insignia is committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where every team member can thrive. If you are passionate about making a difference in the environment and want to join a team that values excellence and camaraderie, we would love to hear from you!

Interested applicants should submit a resume. We request that applicants refrain from calling our office directly regarding this position.

Job Description

Organizational Overview:

KIPP Atlanta Schools is part of the KIPP (Knowledge is Power Program) national network of free, open enrollment, college preparatory schools dedicated to ensuring that every child grows up free to create the future they want for themselves and their communities. There are 280 KIPP schools in 21 states and the District of Columbia serving more than 175,000 scholars and alumni. KIPP Atlanta currently operates 11 schools including five primary schools, six middle schools and one high school, as well as KIPP Forward which supports scholars on their journey to a choice-filled life. We are a social justice organization and our vision and mission require the work of dedicated, bold and skilled leaders, educators, and support staff who are committed to serving as the catalyst for joyful, academically excellent schools and the foundation for building a more just and equitable world for our scholars.

Job Summary

The Data Analyst supports the creation and maintenance of the regional data analysis, reporting, and use strategy. Reporting to the Managing Director of Data and Analytics, the Data Analyst will manage, analyze, and report on school-level and regional data from various sources (e.g., academic, operations, demographic, etc.) pertinent to the regional strategic plan. The Data Analyst will support implementation of organizational data strategies around driving decision-making and instructional practices through analyses and capacity building.

Job Responsibilities

Data Analysis, Application, and Action

70%

Design, implement, and monitor the use of real-time data reports and dashboards (e.g., Tableau reports) to support strategic decisions at the regional and school-level. Seek feedback from teammates and end users to improve the product. Provide training and coaching on using reports and dashboards
Collaborate with the broader Data Team to define regional data analysis and reporting plan and deliverables
Conduct descriptive and predictive analytical work on outputs from KIPP Atlanta’s student information system, student assessments, teacher evaluations, and other organizational data platforms
Translate data into relevant insights and implications and support stakeholders on interpreting findings. Tailor the complexity of analysis appropriately to audiences with various data literacy skills (e.g., regional team, principals, teachers, Board members, funders, etc.) Anticipate and empathize with stakeholder reactions
Assist with mentoring school and organizational leaders on using data to improve instructional planning and drive student achievement
Support implementation of a central access point for most relevant data reports and dashboards and ensure functionality of reports within the access solution
Maintain an in-depth knowledge of all regionally standardized data sources and systems, being constantly aware of new updates and incorporating changes into analytical approach and data visualizations
Execute on external and internal data requests related to student or staff information and other relevant school-level or student-level data

Data Strategy, Management & Support

30%

Collaborate with the Managing Director of Data and Analytics, as well as various stakeholders, to identify key metrics and ensure the effective collection of data for analysis, suggesting and exploring new lines of analysis with colleagues
Build and maintain positive relationships with stakeholders, fostering questions and opportunities for support, while seeking ways to enhance their ability to use data
Plan and lead training sessions for school and regional staff on utilizing data systems and interpreting data reports, contributing to a broader strategy to meet the organization's data needs
Work with teammates to analyze current and future data requirements of teams and departments, actively participating in a cross-functional data/analytics/compliance team to facilitate evidence gathering, processing, and action across the organization
Collaborate with other Data Team members to develop and maintain data warehouse of all relevant data sources while maintaining and troubleshooting the integrity of data linkages between data source systems and data warehouse
Develop an understanding of KIPP Atlanta’s data model and systems integration processes to enable tool building and data quality investigations

Qualifications

Job Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree is required
Minimum of 5 years relevant experience, preferably in the education or non-profit fields
Strong project management skills
Robust quantitative and analytical skills, including experience working with large data sets to derive insights
Knowledge of the education field, including familiarity with current student data systems (e.g., student information systems such as Infinite Campus and/or eSchoolPlus, assessment platforms such as Illuminate Education and NWEA MAP, behavior platforms such as Kickboard and LiveSchool, etc.) and relevant data sets (e.g., demographics student achievement data, attendance/behavior, etc.)
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word); advanced skills with Excel
Experience with data visualization and dashboard creation tools (i.e., Tableau)
Experience training and communicating data and analytics products to audiences of varying levels of expertise
Experience programming in data analysis languages and/or software (e.g., SQL, R, Stata, SPSS).
Enthusiasm for data, analytics, and data-driven decision making
Proven ability to set and meet challenging targets
Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail
Excellent customer service, interpersonal, and communication skills and ability to build meaningful relationships quickly

Compensation is competitive and aligned with KIPP Atlanta Schools’ leadership salary bands. The salary range for this role is $75,000- $112,500 and is based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Most new hires are placed in the lower to mid-range of the salary range. Placement near the top of the range is uncommon at hire and reserved for individuals who exceed role qualifications through depth of expertise, leadership maturity, and proven results leading complex initiatives with sustained, organization-level impact. A comprehensive benefits package is offered, including health insurance, retirement options, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

KIPP Atlanta Schools offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

20 days of Paid Time Off, in addition to identified holidays
Comprehensive health insurance (medical and dental), life insurance and optional short and long term disability
Counseling and Telehealth Options
Paid Parental Leave
Participation in Georgia retirement plan and an optional 403(b) retirement plan.

Location & Work Conditions:

This Position Requires

This role requires schedule flexibility; work hours vary based on campus needs and may include evenings and occasional weekends.
This position has hybrid flexibility but does require regular presence on campus and in schools and in required meetings around the region; Must be based in Atlanta
This position requires routine physical activity associated with normal office environments.
This position may require the ability to lift and carry objects weighing up to 25 pounds.
Ability to engage in school-based activities requiring standing, walking, and mobility

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Who We Are

HII – Mission Technologies is seeking a Data Analyst. The Data Analyst provides critical, timely, and data‑driven insights to support decision‑making processes and strengthen defenses against supply chain vulnerabilities and adversarial threats to industry IT systems. We’re looking for a Mid-Level Environmental Engineer/Geologist/Scientist to continue their career at Jacobs – where we’ll empower you to learn and grow in the delivery of environmental site characterization and remediation projects for government and global private-sector clients to make our world better.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Deployment
jobs.description:
About The Role

The Project Coordinator provides project administration, coordination, and operational support to the Deployment team throughout the project lifecycle, helping ensure projects remain organized, on schedule, and positioned for successful execution of high-profile, large-format advertising infrastructure projects.

As the organizational hub of the project team, they help connect internal departments, consultants, contractors, vendors, and project managers by maintaining accurate project information, coordinating documentation, tracking progress, and supporting day-to-day project operations. This role is ideal for an organized, proactive professional who enjoys solving problems, managing details, and contributing to the successful delivery of complex construction projects.

What You'll Do

Support project managers throughout the project lifecycle, from project initiation through construction and closeout.
Maintain project schedules and milestone tracking.
Coordinate project meetings, document meeting minutes, and distribute follow-up items.
Prepare recurring project status reports and maintain reporting dashboards.
Assist with the preparation, coordination, and administration of contracts, purchase orders, change orders, and other project documentation.
Support project budget tracking, cost reporting, and forecasting activities.
Process project invoices and support invoice approvals.
Coordinate design review meetings and track engineering and design deliverables.
Track procurement activities, fabrication schedules, and material deliveries.
Coordinate project communications among Development, Design, Operations, Finance, consultants, contractors, and vendors.
Assist with scheduling site visits and supporting construction activities.
Maintain project punch lists and track completion of outstanding items.
Maintain project information within Salesforce and other project management systems.
Support the development and continuous improvement of project management processes, templates, and documentation standards
Provide general administrative and operational support to the Deployment team as needed.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Business, or a related field.
2–3 years of experience supporting construction, engineering, architecture, development, or project management teams.
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
Experience using Salesforce or similar project management and tracking systems.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate project documentation.
Willingness to travel up to 25% to project sites throughout the United States.

Preferred

Experience supporting commercial construction, infrastructure, engineering, development, or specialty construction projects.
Familiarity with construction drawings, permitting, procurement, and contract administration.
Experience with budgeting, invoice processing, purchase orders, and project financial tracking.
Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, including consultants, contractors, and vendors.
Exposure to digital signage, LED technology, structural steel, electrical systems, or out-of-home advertising is a plus.

Success in This Role

Bring exceptional organization and attention to detail to every project.
Build strong working relationships across cross-functional teams and external partners.
Communicate proactively and consistently follow through on commitments.
Keep project information organized, accurate, and accessible.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing multiple active projects.
Demonstrate initiative, accountability, and a willingness to learn.
Contribute to a collaborative team culture focused on delivering complex, high-quality projects.

Career Development

The Project Coordinator role provides broad exposure to every phase of delivering large-format advertising infrastructure projects—from engineering and permitting through procurement, construction, and project closeout. Team members develop a strong foundation in project coordination, construction administration, project controls, and cross-functional collaboration while working alongside experienced Project Managers on some of the industry's most visible media installations.

As experience and responsibilities grow, this position offers a defined pathway to advancement into Project Manager and Senior Project Manager roles within the Deployment team.

Company Overview

Orange Barrel Media (OBM) creates and operates iconic urban media displays that advertisers ask for by name in top U.S. markets. Since our founding in 2004, OBM has pioneered a community-oriented model of outdoor media development and is nationally recognized by cities and real estate owners alike seeking to implement premier media programs that add to the character of urban places. In the advertising community, OBM is widely recognized as the owner of the highest impact and most memorable advertising locations in the cities where it operates.

The OBM team is also a leader in smart city infrastructure, launching the Interactive Kiosk Experience (IKE) platform in concert with cities across the U.S. through the company IKE Smart City. IKE is a best-in-class public engagement platform that helps cities communicate with the public, enliven the pedestrian experience, and tell the story of their city. The core pillars of the IKE platform are public benefit and social equity, values that we seek to maximize in every IKE market to achieve city objectives and exceed community expectations.

We are a place where people are inspired to achieve success, genuinely like each other, and have endless opportunities to grow.

Learn more at www.obm.com and www.ikesmartcity.com.

Job Summary

The purpose of the project coordinator position is to assist the project manager(s) by providing project support in key areas including assisting in project design; establishing project documentation; maintaining and/or establishing vendor contracts using the Supply Chain process; processing project invoices and monitoring project budget variances. Additionally, the project coordinator may provide project oversight in absence of the project manager. The project coordinator will also manage smaller projects, usually less than 2–3 weeks in duration, including managing vendors, customer expectations and the project budget. The project coordinator acts as the department’s SharePoint administrator to ensure all project documentation is scanned and filed appropriately. Strong emphasis is placed on providing a positive response to the concerns and needs of the customer.

Major Job Responsibilities

Functional Expertise:

Manages renovation projects with limited time frames (usually less than 2-3 week duration) or with budgets expected to be less than $100K.
Assists project manager(s) by coordinating proper vendor contracts with Supply Chain Management to ensure compliance.
Assist project manager(s) by monitoring project spend against established budget and report accrual(s) and appropriate documentation to Accounting, when necessary.
Performs cost analysis and itemizes project budget before composing accounting documentation and submitting for approval.
Assemble, organize and maintain electronic project documentation via the department’s Sharepoint site for future reference.

Provides input to management with regards to how projects might affect daily operations, processes or procedures.

Monitors against metrics and deliverables, holding self and others/vendors accountable for results.
Identifies and drives process improvement initiatives, including value engineering items in construction projects.

Tracks and reports changes that have been identified as having the ability to cause variances in overall project budget.

(Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills)

Tetra Tech is adding an Engineering Geologist to our team based in Diamond Bar, CA. The group specializes in geotechnical engineering and geologic assessment projects mostly locally in southern California and also regularly in the Southwest United States and occasionally internationally. Our projects include dams and levees, mines, landfills, brownfield redevelopments, infrastructure projects as well as conventional geotechnical engineering projects, and forensic services and peer review services. Our clients are well diversified between state and local agencies (cities and counties), federal agencies (USACE, FEMA, FERC) as well as nationwide private and public clients. The pay scale for this position is $130,000 to $170,000 annually based on qualifications and experience.


You will have the opportunity to grow your technical and business skills and contribute to some of the most complex engineering projects. We offer comprehensive benefits, competitive salary and an entrepreneurial career path that values innovation and excellence.


The selected candidate should have at least 15 years of direct professional experience in geotechnical consulting. You should be proficient in advanced geotechnical field work, geological analyses, and project management tasks. We are a collaborative team comprised of geotechnical engineers, engineering geologists, advanced degree professionals, as well as field staff and consultants frequently working on multi\-disciplinary projects across several operating units at Tetra Tech.

**Your Role**:

* Perform and/or manage geotechnical field investigations, fault studies, site inspections, and construction observations and testing
* Perform analyses of collected field data, laboratory data and published data for the purpose of developing appropriate geotechnical design recommendations suitable for civil/structural design, permitting, certification and assessment.
* Perform geologic evaluation tasks, including geologic maps and cross\-sections, borehole and trench logs, and written descriptions of geologic conditions
* Perform geologic hazard evaluations with focus on fault studies, landsliding
* Prepare and/or assist in the preparation of design reports
* Provide mentorship to junior staff

 **Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in geology and at least 15 years of direct relevant professional experience
* PG and CEG, or the ability to sit for a CEG exam
* Proficiency in geologic field logging of borings, test pits, and trenches
* Proficiency in geologic field mapping
* Management of field and office staff
* Analyses of engineering geological data
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Some competency in illustration software is also desirable, e.g., Autocad, Adobe Illustrator, CorelDraw, ArcGIS
* Preparation of proposals and reports
* Self\-starter, analytical, and possess excellent computer, writing, and oral communication skills
* Experience in field investigation and construction quality assurance activities
* Some travel (up to approximately 20% \- 25%) should be anticipated
* The applicant must be able to work outdoors under varying weather conditions, travel by foot over rough terrain, and lift at least 40 pounds


**Life at Tetra Tech:**  

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

* Comprehensive and market\-competitive benefits.
* Merit\-based financial rewards.
* Flexibility and company\-wide commitment to work/life balance.
* Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
* Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

 **About Tetra Tech:**  

Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high\-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 25,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

About Foundation for Women Warriors

Foundation for Women Warriors (FFWW) is a 106-year-old nonprofit organization dedicated to honoring and empowering women veterans and their families. We enhance the economic and overall well-being of women veterans by providing financial assistance, childcare support, financial education, professional development, and a strong community of support that helps them thrive. 

Position Summary

The Program Coordinator serves as a primary point of contact for women veterans seeking support through Foundation for Women Warriors' programs. This position conducts intake assessments, identifies participant needs, coordinates appropriate program services, provides ongoing case oversight, and monitors participant progress toward achieving personal and financial stability. 

The Program Coordinator is responsible for maintaining accurate client records, tracking program outcomes, supporting grant reporting requirements, and ensuring veterans receive high-quality, compassionate service throughout their engagement with the organization. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Veteran Support & Case Oversight

Conduct intake interviews and comprehensive needs assessments to determine eligibility and appropriate program services. 
Identify barriers to services and develop strategies to help veterans successfully access available resources. 
Clearly communicate program expectations, eligibility requirements, timelines, and next steps. 
Provide ongoing case oversight through regular follow-up and quarterly check-ins. 
Assist veterans in developing personal budgets, setting financial goals, and improving financial literacy to promote long-term self-sufficiency. 
Support veterans in identifying and securing housing, childcare, and other essential community resources. 
Assist with applications and prepare documentation, including payment or check requests, as needed. 
Review veteran surveys and assessments to identify additional support needs and opportunities for long-term success. 

Program Administration & Data Management

Maintain accurate, timely, and complete case documentation within the organization's client management system. 
Ensure the integrity and confidentiality of client records while complying with organizational policies and funder requirements. 
Collect, monitor, and report program outcomes and grant-required performance metrics using Apricot or other designated databases. 
Conduct periodic audits of client files to ensure documentation accuracy and compliance. 
Collaborate with the team to support reporting, data analysis, and program evaluation. 
Prepare internal and external reports highlighting program activities, outcomes, and impact. 
Review veteran applications for completeness, accuracy, and financial sustainability. 
Maintain reporting calendars and ensure compliance with grant deadlines, reporting requirements, and program deliverables. 

Program Support & Organizational Engagement

Participate in staff meetings, trainings, community events, and professional development opportunities. 
Collaborate with team members on program improvements, special projects, and strategic initiatives. 
Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of program goals, objectives, and participant services. 
Perform other duties as assigned. 

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. 
Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail. 
Ability to build trusting relationships with veterans while maintaining professional boundaries. 
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a collaborative team. 
Experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
Strong database management and data entry skills. 
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and client management software (CRM/database systems). 
Excellent online research skills and ability to connect veterans with appropriate community resources. 
Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and exercising sound professional judgment. 

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Human Services, Psychology, Public Administration, or a related field preferred. 
Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Senior Geologist/Senior Environmental Scientist
for our Peoria or Springfield, IL
office location. We’re seeking an environmental professional to assist in the planning, permitting, execution, and delivery of environmental investigation and remediation projects across the Midwest. This includes Phase I and Phase II projects, as well as RCRA Permitting/Corrective Action and CERCLA projects. The ideal candidate brings strong investigation expertise, remedial alternative selection and implementation, and the ability to navigate complex regulatory environments ensuring project performance, budget, schedule, and regulatory requirements.

Your Impact

With minimal supervision, assist with collecting, extracting, identifying, and compiling environmental data from soil sampling, soil gas sampling, groundwater sampling, stormwater sampling, boring logs, and other matrices for projects, investigations, and surveys.
Actively engage in business development and proposal writing.
Ensure regulatory requirement compliance pertaining to the data integrity, documentation, procedures, training, monitoring systems, and record compliance and retention.
Perform professional environmental science work and conduct investigations, inspections, and environmental studies and surveys to gain further information on a particular environmental problem or issue, verify site characteristics, and/or to plan for future environmental needs.
Conduct environmental site assessments (Phase I and II).
Prepare data and visualizations such as tables, charts, reports, models, cross-sections, and other illustrations for the interpretation or presentation of more complex data, findings, or analyses.
Prepare comprehensive technical reports and presentations that explain research, findings, and recommendations to address, prevent, control, or restore mid- to larger-scale environmental problems.
Oversee and monitor cross-functional teams in executing project work, permitting strategy, environmental impact assessments, and regulatory compliance, including project budgets, tracking hours and expenses, and task completion.
Provide high level oversite for desk-based research, fieldwork, and/or laboratory work, including measurements, data interpretation, and computer modeling.

Collaborate with professionals from a variety of disciplines to provide future ready solutions for clients.

Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

BS or BA in Geology, Hydrogeology, Earth Science or Environmental Science.
7 to 10 years of experience working as an environmental professional and completing environmental surveys, fieldwork, habitat and impact assessments, and/or construction monitoring.
Appropriate professional licensure/certification.

Demonstrated experience leading and reviewing environmental science technical reports, environmental impact evaluations, siting reports, and environmental permit applications and licensing, including field surveys and reporting, and resource and impact evaluations (e.g. commercial, renewable energy, infrastructure, etc.)
Highly capable self-leadership and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively, persuasively, and tactfully interact with employees at all levels of the organization.
Ability to work independently and provide guidance and leadership to junior team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Proficiency with technical writing, office automation and communication software, technology, and tools.
Well-developed critical thinking and problem-solving skills required to reach conclusions from testing results, data collation, and identify the most effective solutions to accomplish objectives of assigned projects.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Ability to work schedules conducive to project-specific requirements that may extend beyond the typical workweek.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.
40-Hour OSHA Health & Safety Training (HAZWOPER) (29 CFR 1910.120).
Basic First Aid and Adult CPR training desired.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Tetra Tech is looking for a full-time Environmental Scientist
based in Joplin, MO.

Position Summary

We are seeking an Entry-level or Junior-level Environmental Scientist to provide support on various environmental projects throughout Iowa, Nebraska, Kansas and Missouri. This position will primarily support investigations and removal activities at former lead mining areas in southeast Kansas and southwest Missouri. Site locations include, Caney, KS, Iola, KS, Cherokee County, KS, Jasper County, MO and Newton County, MO. However, work at other sites throughout the four-state area may also be required.

In this position you will be part of a project team, gaining valuable data collection experience in the field and preparing detailed analysis of field data and project reports. Tetra Tech provides mentoring and training opportunities to help junior staff hone their areas of expertise and diversify their interests. Tetra Tech also provides tuition assistance and supports other professional development opportunities for its employees.

Essential Job Functions

The following duties are considered essential to the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions:

Collect soil samples from residential properties where permission has been granted by the property owner.
Prepare samples for analysis via an x-ray florescence (XRF) spectrometer.
Analyze soil samples for lead and other heavy metals using an XRF spectrometer.
Prepare field sketches and other documentation related to residential soil sampling.
Provide oversight of excavation crews contracted to remove lead-contaminated soils from residential properties.
Coordination with other project team members and residents to ensure all work is completed to the satisfaction of EPA.
Preparation of sampling plans and health and safety plans.
Field studies requiring the collection of soil, groundwater and indoor air samples.
Interpretation of sample data and preparation of data summary reports.
Regular maintenance and calibration of equipment used during field studies.
Support other environmental studies throughout the four-state region.
This position will require extensive outdoor work and may occasionally require overnight travel.

In Addition, The Following Is Required

Passing a criminal background check.
Driving on a regular basis. Passing a motor vehicle record background check and maintaining a valid driver's license and good driving record is required.

Why Tetra Tech

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 60 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Your Impact

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. If the successful candidate does not already possess this training, Tetra Tech will provide training prior to initiating regular work duties in the field.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills (both written and verbal).
Highly motivated, customer-focused and work well in a team environment.
Proficiency with MS Word and Excel.
Driving on a regular basis. Passing a motor vehicle record background check and maintaining a valid driver's license and good driving record is required.

Physical Requirements

Work Environment / Environmental Factors

This position will require extensive outdoor work within the four-state area of Missouri, Kansas, Iowa and Nebraska during all seasons, including peak summer and winter conditions.
Most work is anticipated to occur in the eastern Missouri area; however occasional overnight travel may be required for projects located outside this area.

jobs.description:
Entarian is seeking a Great Lakes Habitat Restoration Specialist
to provide technical, programmatic, data management, environmental compliance, outreach, and restoration planning support for the NOAA Office of Habitat Conservation, Restoration Center. This position will support habitat restoration projects and related NOAA programs and initiatives in the Great Lakes region, including work associated with the Community Based Restoration Program and Damage Assessment Remediation and Restoration Program. The position is remote, with periodic on-site meetings in Ann Arbor, MI, and/or regional site visits and meetings with partners throughout the Great Lakes states.

Duties Include

Support fishery habitat restoration planning and implementation, including the evaluation, identification, prioritization, design, implementation, and monitoring of restoration projects that support NOAA Restoration Center priorities, including CRP and DARRP.
Provide technical and programmatic support for Great Lakes restoration projects, including coordination with NOAA staff, co-trustees, local partners, responsible parties, technical professionals, and other stakeholders to support project development, implementation planning, monitoring, and reporting.
Support project review, tracking, and contract-related coordination, including technical review of project proposals and progress reports, support for field activities and subcontractor oversight, identification of potential contract deviations, and coordination with the NOAA Project Lead and COR as appropriate.
Develop and support technical, scientific, outreach, and environmental compliance documentation, including restoration planning materials, NEPA and permitting documentation, project fact sheets, briefing packets, draft press releases, maps, story-maps, and other products.
Perform data management, GIS, and reporting activities, including maintaining and inputting project data in office systems; supporting mapping and geospatial analysis; coordinating information requests; and preparing monthly progress reports that correlate cost, level of effort, activities, and accomplishments.

The salary for this position is approximately $70,000 - 94,000/year.

Some local travel for meetings, regional site visits, workshops, trainings, and conferences required; candidates must reside within the Great Lakes basin.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in coastal or aquatic sciences, fishery biology, fish ecology, hydrology, water resources, ecology, environmental science, biological sciences, or a related field. One year of additional relevant experience may be substituted for each year of degree deficiency, consistent with contract requirements.
Minimum 5–8 years of professional experience in applicable field activities, methods, and practices related to habitat restoration, fisheries, ecology, aquatic sciences, or a related field.
Demonstrated ability to support fishery habitat restoration planning, implementation, monitoring, and project evaluation.
Knowledge of biological sciences and techniques pertaining to ecology, marine and anadromous fisheries, offshore and coastal aquatic habitat, invasive species, and Great Lakes habitats and resources.
Ability to apply ecological principles to habitat restoration.
Knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations related to living marine resources and habitat restoration projects, including the Clean Water Act, Essential Fish Habitat guidelines, Estuary Restoration Act, Endangered Species Act, Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act, and Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act.
Ability to perform field monitoring and habitat assessment activities to identify and evaluate habitat restoration projects.
Experience coordinating with technical professionals, local partners, co-trustees, responsible parties, agencies, and other stakeholders.
Strong organizational and project management skills, including project scheduling, budgeting, tracking, reporting, and handling multiple concurrent responsibilities.
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently; reliable, self-starter, self-motivated, and detail-oriented.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Willingness for occasional travel within the Great Lakes region.
Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident and be able to pass a background investigation to obtain a security badge to access applicable government systems and facilities.

Desired Qualifications

Experience with GIS mapping and analysis
Technical writing skills and experience
Experience working in a government office

The Data Analyst position will assist with maintenance of department database and on-going training of end users. This position is responsible for gathering, analyzing and reporting statistical information and patient outcomes to both external and internal customers which may include statistical power and sample size determination, inferential hypothesis testing, algorithm development and numerical methods, data mining and knowledge discovery in databases. Reporting duties for the Data Analyst position will involve the provision of monthly departmental reports and ensuring timely regulatory reporting completion. jobs.title: Environmental Scientist/Fish Biologist
jobs.description:
Environmental Scientist/Fish Biologist

**Introduction:**

Point Environmental LLC is a small consulting firm based in Oregon City which helps its clients maintain compliance with environmental regulations in the construction and resource management industries throughout Oregon and Washington. The company is looking for a full\-time **Environmental Scientist/Fish Biologist** (Bio) to serve primarily in our southern service area. The southern service area extends from Oregon City to Eugene, and the company would prefer to hire an individual who currently resides between Oregon City and Salem.

The Bio will be assigned equipment, a company vehicle, and will be expected to report to jobsites or the Oregon City office directly from their residence the majority of the time. Therefore, their residence should be in the southern service area but within comfortable commuting distance of the Oregon City office at 914 Molalla Ave, Oregon City, OR 97045\.

The Bio’s primary responsibilities will involve providing environmental permit compliance and construction site erosion and sediment control inspection. The Bio’s other duties will include various environmental compliance tasks, particularly assisting with fish rescue/salvage operations during the summer in\-water work period, ESA species compliance, CWA compliance, and NEPA compliance.

The Bio is expected to work normal hours from 8am to 5pm Monday through Friday, but within that time, will be largely managing their own schedule which varies depending on weather conditions and project activities. Therefore, the individual needs to be self\-motivated and highly dependable.

**Responsibilities include:**

· Travel to multiple sites in Oregon, Washington, and occasionally Idaho

· Construction site inspection

· Fish salvage

· Remote stream survey

· Log entries using written and digital formats

· Thorough photo documentation

· Record keeping

· Report writing

· Communication with superintendents, foreman, and clients

· Spending long periods of time on your feet walking in inclement weather and rough terrain

**Job Requirements:**

· Bachelor's degree in fish biology, environmental science, or similar field

· At least **one (1\) of the** following Oregon DEQ acceptable erosion and sediment control inspection certifications:

o Certified Professional in Erosion and Sediment Control (CPESC)

o Certified Professional in Storm Water Quality (CPSWQ)

o Certified Erosion and Sediment Control Lead (CESCL)

o Rogue Valley Sewer Services Erosion and Sediment Control Certification

· Minimum 1 year experience (Please Include a List of Projects)

· Valid driver’s license

· Need to provide own weather appropriate clothing including above the ankle leather work boots. Point Environmental will provide the necessary safety PPE.

· Must currently have reliable transportation.

· A motivated and organized individual with honesty, integrity, who wants to work, and who is willing to learn and share their individuality and ideas to better the company.

· Construction casual attire and appearance, e.g. jeans or kakis with collard shirt or Point Environmental T\-shirt.

· Experience with Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat Pro

**Job Preferences:**

· Preference will be given to those individuals with an educational emphasis and additional work experience in fish biology, electrofishing, forestry, civil construction, QGIS, etc.

**Compensation:**

The Bio will be an “at will” employee who will receive an hourly compensation commensurate with experience.

**Hiring Schedule:**

Immediately. Interviews will be scheduled with acceptable candidates.

**Benefits:**

Health/Dental insurance is available for employees working 30 hours a week or more.

Paid time off

Remote work

Company vehicle or paid mileage

Career training

Self\-management, flexible

Small company, relaxed atmosphere

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they're doing. At Workday, we're committed to bringing passion for data and a focus on actionable insights to the Marketing organization. Our Content Marketing Analytics team plays a key role in helping the broader Marketing team understand what's working, where to invest, and how to continuously improve the content experiences we create for our audiences.

We help shape content strategy through data—turning complex performance metrics into clear, meaningful recommendations that guide how we plan, create, and distribute content. Whether it's identifying what resonates with our audiences, tracking performance against goals, or uncovering new opportunities through digital analytics, our work directly influences how Workday shows up in the market.

We work hard, and we're serious about what we do. But we like to have a good time, too. In fact, we run our company with that principle in mind every day: one of our core values is fun.

About The Role

As a Digital Content Data Analyst, you will be a key member of the Content Marketing Analytics team, responsible for owning and managing the end-to-end analytics process for content marketing. You will use tools like Adobe Analytics, Snowflake, Sigma, ContentSquare, BrandWatch, and Google Search Console to track, analyze, and report on digital content performance across channels. Your insights will help the team make informed decisions to optimize campaigns, improve customer experiences, and contribute to business growth.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

Determining strategic goals and direction for Content Marketing using data and analysis
Owning and managing the end-to-end analytics process for Content Marketing, including data collection, reporting, and insight generation across platforms such as Adobe Analytics, Sigma, ContentSquare, BrandWatch, and Google Search Console
Delivering quarterly analytics reviews that include blog performance, goal tracking, and strategic recommendations for upcoming quarters and annual planning
Representing Content Marketing in cross-functional discussions related to a Corporate Communications analytics framework
Collaborating with the broader Marketing Insights Systems Orchestration team on cross-functional projects and data initiatives
Transforming raw data into clear, compelling narratives that inform content strategy and help partners across Marketing understand performance trends

About You

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of related experience in data analytics, digital analytics, or a similar role
Experience with Adobe Analytics or a similar web analytics platform
Experience working with data warehousing tools such as Snowflake or similar platforms

Other Qualifications

Skilled in data analysis, with experience inspecting, cleansing, transforming, and modeling data to discover useful information and support decision-making, using tools and techniques such as statistical analysis, data visualization, and SQL
Experienced in analytical thinking, with the ability to break down complex data into fundamental parts, identify patterns and trends in datasets, and apply logical reasoning to solve problems and inform strategy
Proficient in data operations, with an understanding of the collection, processing, storage, and distribution of data, including experience improving data quality and implementing effective data governance practices
Knowledgeable in business analysis, with the ability to evaluate organizational operations, interpret data to identify areas for improvement, and provide recommendations that support strategic planning and decision-making
Experienced in data transformation, with the ability to convert data from one format or structure into another, clean and standardize data for analysis, and design effective transformation workflows
Capable of sound decision making, with the ability to evaluate multiple options, assess potential outcomes, and select the best course of action to support content marketing goals and operational improvements
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex data findings clearly to diverse audiences and collaborate effectively across teams

Location:
Oakland, CA

Hybrid — up to 2 days per week onsite at Oakland General Office

Contract

Job Summary

The Data Analyst
is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive operational and strategic decision-making. This role requires an exceptional communicator who can clearly explain data, assumptions, and insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike. The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Power BI
for reporting and visualization and Foundry for advanced analytics and data modeling, and is comfortable working across multiple enterprise systems and teams.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights

Analyze business data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities for operational and strategic improvements
Demonstrate broad expertise in data processing and analysis, applying analytical techniques to a wide range of business questions
Respond to ad hoc and recurring data requests with accuracy, clarity, and timeliness

Data Management & Integration

Collect, clean, validate, and integrate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency
Extract and analyze data from SAP to support planning, forecasting, and decision-making
Manage data extraction and transfer from databases to support operational analysis across teams
Create automated data routines and processes to ensure efficient, repeatable reporting and data delivery

Reporting, Visualization & Tools

Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI to clearly communicate insights and performance metrics
Utilize Foundry for advanced analytics, data modeling, and analytical workflows (knowledge of Foundry is preferred, not a requirement)
Apply GIS tools for spatial data analysis and mapping to support location-based decision-making
Leverage Copperleaf for asset investment planning, lifecycle cost analysis, and value-based decision support (knowledge of Copperleaf is preferred, not a requirement)

Communication & Collaboration (Core Requirement)

Clearly communicate analytical findings, assumptions, and recommendations to diverse audiences
Translate complex data into concise, compelling narratives that support informed decision-making
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, identify challenges, and deliver data-driven solutions
Act as a trusted partner to stakeholders by helping shape analytical questions and clarify insights

Required Skills

Data analytics using Python, Excel, and conducting data queries as needed
Power BI
— advanced skills, with ability to create executive boards AND day-to-day dashboards for business analytics
SAP — experience extracting and analyzing data to support planning, forecasting, and decision-making
Microsoft Excel and Power Query as needed
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI
Strong SQL
skills and experience working with structured datasets
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to explain complex data clearly
Strong ability to interpret data, identify trends, and generate actionable insights
Ability to clearly communicate complex data findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience working in cross-functional teams and translating business needs into data-driven solutions
Problem solving mentality
Impeccable organization skills
Agility
Impeccable communication skills

Preferred Skills

Hands-on experience using Foundry for data analysis, data modeling, or workflows
Experience with Copperleaf
Willingness to learn Copperleaf, Foundry, GIS, and other platforms

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Work Environment / Physical Requirements

Local candidates only — submissions restricted to the client's service territory
Hybrid schedule — up to 2 days per week onsite at Oakland General Office
Client laptop will be provided once available; a vendor-issued laptop is acceptable to access the client network via VPN/Citrix until a client laptop is issued
No additional equipment will be provided; any additional equipment needed is the responsibility of the supplier

About the Client

This client is a major utility and energy company
serving approximately 16 million people across a 70,000-square-mile service area spanning northern and central California, making it one of the largest combined natural gas and electric energy utilities in the United States. With roughly 25,000 employees, the organization operates some of the most complex energy infrastructure in the country — including transmission lines, pipelines, substations, and generation facilities — and is actively navigating the intersection of traditional infrastructure and emerging clean energy solutions. The company draws engineers, technologists, data analysts, business professionals, and tradespeople who are motivated by the scale, stability, and meaningful mission of delivering safe, reliable energy to millions of Californians every day.

GTT is a minority-owned staffing firm and a subsidiary of Chenega Corporation, a Native American-owned company in Alaska. We highly value diverse and inclusive workplaces and support Fortune 500 organizations across banking, financial services, technology, life sciences, biotech, utilities, and retail sectors throughout the U.S. and Canada.

jobs.description:
Sr. Data Analyst (Contract) – Global Real Estate Organization

Role Description

This role is a contract assignment at Palo Alto Networks. Contractors will not be employed by Palo Alto Networks but through our trusted staffing partners.

The Sr. Data Analyst (Contract) will leverage AI and automation best practices to engage in highly technical data analysis and projects in support of the Global Real Estate Organization. These projects may include budget analyses, real estate portfolio analyses, sourcing proposal and supplier analysis, office occupancy and utilization analyses, dashboarding and visualization, and leadership reporting.

Location: Santa Clara, CA (Hybrid 3X a week to office)
Duration: 12 Months
Visa sponsorship assistance is not available for this position

Responsibilities

The Global Real Estate Org has an annual operating budget exceeding $500M+ supporting over 120 international offices. The Sr. Data Analyst will Leverage AI to automate annual Budget Planning for Opex and Capex and oversee monthly Budget vs. Actual spend analysis including building and ongoing management of dashboards (i.e. leverage Google Looker Studio)
Find, review, understand, and analyze data from various programs within the Global Real Estate Organization to drive optimal resource utilization
Develop data insights that help drive financial and operational decisions
Develop trend and forecast analyses for the organization's $300M+ annual budget and real estate portfolio
Maintain digital infrastructure enabling the Budget Compliance including the Procure to Pay, New Purchase Order, and Purchase Order “add funds” processes
Design, implement. and support Global Real Estate dashboards for space utilization, badge access / employee attendance, and financials → need to have the skillset and knowledge to be able to pull data from different sources (i.e. Workday, Ariba, LeaseCalcs, Space IQ, Envoy, etc.) and consolidate in central dashboards for Executive Leadership
Design and create analyses to present actionable insights related to data sets and business questions at hand
Build models that will better detect financial anomalies (eg. Accrual vs. Invoices)
Build end to end data pipelines and self serving dashboards. Drive for efficiency and automate whatever you can!
Gain a deep understanding about the process and data flows involved; document and train internal personnel to institutionalize the learnings of the data analytics practice

Experience

5+ years of Experience with data visualization tools (Looker Studio, Tableau, PowerBI, etc)
Programming experience in R, Python, Javascript/Node.js, SQL
Experience developing REST API integrations
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Excellent analytical skills - ability to break down a complex problem into its primitives
Ability to manage multiple projects and work assignments and ensure that projects are tracking to deliverable dates
Comfortable with ambiguity and handling confidential information
Professional at all times with all levels of the company
Ability to accomplish projects with minimal supervision
Proficiency in Google Workspace tools (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, etc.)
Ability to analyze and compare data to make impactful recommendations
Experience with project management tools and principles (Asana, MS Project, Primavera P6, Smartsheet, Monday.com, etc.)
Ability to quickly grasp, manage, and summarize complex or large data sets
Highly motivated, efficient, organized, and laser-focused on the detail
An interest in hacking things together in order to solve exciting and interesting problems
Team player - demonstrated ability to work well with cross functional team members in a dynamic, fast paced environment
Love to build & innovate - always looking for ways to improve solutions & efficiency
Being a self-starter is a key to success in this role - we face new & unique challenges daily, The successful candidate can collaborate with our stakeholders, listen & understand a business problem, develop & present a recommendation, and implement the solution

Education & Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree + minimum 5 years experience in Economics, Math, Computer Science, Statistics, Management Science or other quantitative field
Advanced in MacOS/Windows, Microsoft Office, and Google Suite (Looker Studio, G: Sheets, Slides, Google Drive, and GMail)
Advanced user in Excel/GSheets involving: formulas use (eg. vlookup, sumif, etc), financial modeling, and experience in creating new models as well as enhancing existing models
Strong understanding of GAAP Accounting Principles and Procure-to-Pay process

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with LeaseCalcs
Experience developing Tableau Web Data connectors
Strategic thinker that is always looking to improve with feedback
Able to prioritize deliverables or projects in deadline-driven situations
Able to set clear expectations with stakeholders, collaborate efficiently with multiple teams, and work independently to get the job done, no matter how big or small the project
Able to clearly communicate purpose or deliverables in meetings with clear agenda
Able to present to and communicate effectively (verbally and in writing) with executives and senior management
MBA in Finance

About The Team

Global Places and Security team’s Mission is, “Act as a data-driven business enabler that ensures a safe and inclusive workplace, protecting our people, property, and brand”. Collaborating with leadership and key stakeholders across America, EMEA, and APAC, this role will be focused on the financial management lifecycle and supplier landscape including annual budget planning, tracking & dashboard reporting actual monthly spend, Requests for Proposals - RFPs, org financial health & savings optimization reporting to leadership, etc. The successful candidate will guide stakeholders to operationalize changes in financial guidance, clearly manage expectations regarding financial processes, and provide analyses enabling the team to make best data driven decisions
Our diverse team consists of passionate individuals who continually strive to deliver innovative solutions, drive efficiencies, and have fun!

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Number: R0243644

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data analyst like you to bring your knowledge to the Navy.

As a client-facing data analyst on our team, you’ll work closely with clients to understand their questions, conduct research, and develop metrics and strategies to guide enterprise-level software and hardware decisions. You will respond to data calls, combine information from multiple sources, and develop detailed analytical reports that can be clearly communicated to teammates, leadership, and stakeholders. You’ll build dashboards and data visualizations, automate repetitive tasks with scripts, and produce standardized reporting to support enterprise licensing, acquisition documentation, and ongoing program needs.

Work with us to help drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

4+ years of experience working with the DoW
2+ years of experience with data engineering in Databricks or Spark
2+ years of experience with Python, R, or SQL for data manipulation and analysis
2+ years of experience performing research, recommending strategies and performance metrics, and supporting business intelligence
Ability to be self-motivated and pay strict attention to detail
Secret clearance
Bachelor's degree

Nice If You Have:

Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, or Seaborn
Experience performing data science and predictive analytics using tools such as Pandas, Polars, Scikit-learn, MLFlow, Pytorch, or Tensorflow
Experience with federal procurement, including for enterprise software
Experience using Power Platform tools such as Canvas Apps and Power Automate
Knowledge of AI engineering
Databricks, Tableau, or Power BI Certification

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your
own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided
.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Act as a point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.

Governance & Compliance

Prepare and coordinate board and committee materials, including agendas, resolutions, and minutes.
Ensure compliance with internal governance processes and document retention policies.

Data Management &Reporting

Maintain accurate data records in trust and client management systems.
Assist with reporting, document control, and information tracking across departments.
Support client intake and onboarding processes.

Project Coordination & Support

Provide administrative and logistical support for internal and client-facing projects.
Coordinate cross-functional efforts between APCTC teams and legal, compliance, and marketing departments.
Track timelines, deliverables, and action items for assigned projects.

Marketing & Business Development Support

Assist in preparing presentations, proposals, and marketing materials.
Provide logistical support for client events and other marketing initiatives.

Meetings & Communication

Schedule, coordinate, and prepare materials for internal and external meetings.
Attend meetings, take minutes, and follow up on action items.
Ensure timely and effective communication across stakeholders.
Perform other related duties as assigned.
Be present during regularly scheduled working hours and as needed in the position, consistent with attendance expectations.

Specific Skills Required

Possesses exceptional organizational and multitasking strengths, with a proven track record of managing time efficiently.
Works autonomously and proactively in fast-paced environments, demonstrating a strong sense of initiative.
Is articulate and professional in both written and spoken communication, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of an organization.

Requires a willingness and interest in obtaining and developing knowledge of the trust and investment process.

Requires a bachelor’s degree (or equivalent combination of education and experience) and 5 to 7+ years of experience in an executive assistant, legal assistant, or similar role, ideally within a trust company, legal, or financial services environment.

jobs.description:
Summary

Job Summary

The CU Student Government Program Coordinator plays a crucial role in supporting CU Student Government (CUSG) across its various branches, including the Executive Branch, Legislative Branch, Judicial Branch, Election Commission, Joint Boards, and Finance Board. This position is responsible for supporting CU Student Government in various administrative functions, including student leader support, hiring, onboarding and managing student employees and leaders, fiscal review and planning, procurement and CUSG board relations.

CU is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. We are committed to creating a workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

Who We Are

The Division of Student Life consists of 36 departments that provide student support and services dedicated to helping students become successful, curious, competent individuals during their time at CU Boulder.

CU Student Government (CUSG)

The University of Colorado Student Government (CUSG) is the official governing body of the over 38,000 students at CU Boulder. As the most autonomous student government in the nation, CUSG is responsible for allocating $37 million in student fees to improve the lives of all CU Boulder students. CUSG seeks to make a meaningful impact on the lives of CU Boulder students through advocacy, representation, allocation and legislation.

Responsibilities

What Your Key Responsibilities Will Be

Student Leader Support

Post and track student job and leadership opportunity announcements using Handshake and other CU specified avenues.
Receive, organize, and forward incoming applications to the appropriate hiring committee.
Inform and provide resources to each member of a hiring committee of CU Boulder’s policy on hiring student employees and best practices while conducting an interview.
Develop and implement position-specific hiring timelines for all CUSG’s positions and student leader positions to ensure compliance with university policy.
Assist in the design and facilitation of training and development for CUSG positions, student staff, and student leader positions.
Schedule interviews with CUSG branch leaders and appropriate stakeholders.
Coordinate the submission and approval of student employee timesheets, handling hiring and onboarding processes, exit procedures, and leave reconciliation.
Supervise and manage departmental student employees.

Administrative Support

Serve as the CUSG liaison with Student Life Employee Experience Liaison, to ensure payroll is processed for part-time salaried and student employees.
Work directly with Student Life Employee Experience to hire all student employees and leaders for CUSG, ensuring accurate pay amounts and term dates.
Assist employees with timekeeping submissions, ensuring accurate and timely processing of bi-weekly and monthly payroll.
Review and monitor CUSG’s student budget with a focus on ensuring staff stays within approved hours and aligns with CU Boulder policy.
In collaboration with Student Life Employee Experience, troubleshoot payroll issues related to hiring, onboarding, and exit procedures.
Coordinate onboarding instructions and support for new student staff hires around payroll information, hiring packets, work-study, supervisory change forms, and separating student staff leaving their position.
Coordinate with Student Life Employee Experience on payroll-related inquiries, hiring transactions, and payment discrepancies.
Manage users and permissions within relevant software, managing accounts and permissions as necessary.
Assist other users in troubleshooting issues related to software used by CUSG..
Coordinate with Office of Financial Aid to understand and address any issues related to the impacts of stipend-based compensation on student leaders.

Fiscal Management

Conduct high-level fiscal planning and reporting in partnership with the Finance Director, Finance Board Chair, CUSG Advisor, CUSG Office Manager, and Student Life Business & Finance, and CUSG.
Process purchase orders, standing purchase orders, and procurement for expenditure requests, ensuring compliance with university policies.
Place orders for office supplies, catering, event-related materials, and other operational needs.
Handle travel arrangements, reservations, and accommodations for CUSG members.
Ensure compliance with the Student Fee Regulations and all university policies.
Ensure all expenditures are appropriately authorized, documented, and reconciled.
Maintain organized financial records and expenditure files.

Finance Board and Joint Board Relations

Support the Finance Board Chair and CUSG Office Manager in managing the budget, financial tracking, and financial board processes.
Coordinate with Student Life Business & Finance to conduct regular check-in meetings and ensure compliance with university policies
Assist with processing invoices, tracking financial transactions, and entering data into financial systems.
Serve as a CUSG liaison between Joint Boards attending meetings and meeting with Chairs as necessary
Assist with Joint Board recruitment and onboarding as needed.
Assist in the design and facilitation of training and development for Joint Board Chairs and Members
Update records, ensuring transparency and accessibility for CUSG leadership and Joint Boards.
Help with website updates related to financial policies, budget allocations, and procurement procedures.

What You Should Know

This is a hybrid work opportunity. The work schedule for this position is Monday - Friday 9:00AM - 5:00 PM, with flextime to attend Finance Board or Joint Board meetings that are later in the evenings.

What We Can Offer

The annual salary range for this full-time position is $58,200 - $65,000.
Onboarding assistance is available within the Student Life division guidelines.

At the University of Colorado Boulder , we are committed to supporting the holistic health and well-being of our employees. Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, and retirement plans; generous paid time off; tuition assistance for you and your dependents; and an ECO Pass for local transit. As one of Boulder County’s largest employers, CU Boulder offers an inspiring academic community and access to world-class outdoor recreation. Explore additional perks and programs through the CU Advantage program.

Be courageous. Be visionary. Be Boulder.

1 year of professional, administrative, student affairs, human resources, finance, payroll, operations, or related experience.

A current resume.
